ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure shows a transition-state structure, with a circled negative sign above; the main body contains a “CCl2” label, indicating one carbon connected to two chlorines; below it there is also a “Cl”, and there is a vertical single bond from the upper carbon position to this lower chlorine. Curved arrows can also be seen in the figure. Then reason: According to the problem statement, ignore the arrows and charge symbol, and exclude hydrogen-related bonds. In CCl2, two C-Cl bonds are implied; the explicitly drawn C-Cl single bond below counts as 1 more. Therefore the total number of bonds is 2 + 1 = 3.
